module: Usage statistics of levels and spawn points for the UI: counts how many times each level/spawn point was launched and when. The data is persisted in `/settings/cloud/uiStats.json` (`levels` table with count, lastUsed, spawnPoints, and `vehicles` table). Global: freeroam_levelStats.
notes: The default spawn point has no name: it is stored under the internal name `__default__` and returned with spawnPointName=nil.
Every recordLevelSpawn rewrites the whole JSON file.
The sorted lists put the most recently used item first, then the others by decreasing launch count (ties: most recent first).

recordLevelSpawn.desc: Increments the counter and the date of the level and of the spawn point, then saves the stats file.

spawnPointName.desc: Spawn point name; nil = default point.

getTopLevels.desc: Levels sorted by usage (last used first, then by count).

getTopSpawnPoints.desc: A level's spawn points sorted the same way.

getUiStats.desc: Groups topLevels and topSpawnPoints (the spawn points of all levels, concatenated, with no level name).
